name: angora-rabbit
draw: Angora rabbit as a big round fluffy puff of long fur with a small face and tufted ears.

name: mara
draw: Patagonian mara in side view with a rabbit-like head on long deer-like legs.

name: mole-animal
draw: Mole in side view with a velvety body, pointed pink snout and large spade-like digging front paws, emerging from a mound.

name: star-nosed-mole
draw: Star-nosed mole face with a star of fleshy tentacles ringing the tip of the nose and large claws.

name: shrew
draw: Shrew in side view with a tiny body, very long pointed whiskered snout and a thin tail.

name: elephant-shrew
draw: Elephant shrew in side view with a long flexible trunk-like snout, big eyes and long thin legs.

name: colugo
draw: Colugo gliding with a wide kite-shaped skin membrane stretched from neck to tail tip.

name: rock-hyrax
draw: Rock hyrax sitting on a rock with a compact round body, short ears and no visible tail.

name: sloth
draw: Sloth hanging upside down from a branch by long curved claws with a smiling face mask.

name: giant-anteater
draw: Giant anteater in side view with a very long tube snout, a diagonal shoulder stripe and a huge bushy tail.

name: armadillo
draw: Armadillo in side view with a banded armored shell, pointed snout, long ears and a tapered tail.

name: pangolin
draw: Pangolin in side view covered in overlapping pointed scales with a long tapering tail.

name: aardvark
draw: Aardvark in side view with an arched back, long tubular snout, long rabbit-like ears and a thick tail.

name: long-eared-bat
draw: Bat face with huge ears almost as long as its body and small wings folded.

name: horseshoe-bat
draw: Horseshoe bat face with a horseshoe-shaped leaf nose and pointed ears, hanging upside down.

name: walrus
draw: Walrus lying in side view with two long downward tusks, a bristly mustache and flippers.

name: orca
draw: Orca in side view with a tall dorsal fin, a white eye patch and a white belly on a dark body.

name: sperm-whale
draw: Sperm whale in side view with a huge square block-shaped head and a narrow lower jaw.

name: narwhal
draw: Narwhal swimming in side view with a long straight spiral tusk projecting from its head.

name: beluga
draw: Beluga whale in side view with a rounded bulging forehead melon, no dorsal fin and a smiling mouth.

name: manatee
draw: Manatee floating in side view with a rounded grey body, small flippers and a round paddle-shaped tail.

name: sea-lion
draw: Sea lion sitting upright on its front flippers with small external ears and a ball balanced on its nose.

name: elephant-seal
draw: Male elephant seal raised up with a large drooping trunk-like nose over its mouth.

name: hooded-seal
draw: Hooded seal head with a large inflated balloon bulging from one nostril.

name: river-dolphin
draw: River dolphin in side view with a very long thin beak, a rounded forehead and a low hump instead of a fin.

name: whale-tail
draw: Whale tail fluke rising vertically out of the water line with a notch in the middle.

name: wombat
draw: Wombat in side view with a stout barrel body, short legs, a broad flat nose and small ears.

name: tasmanian-devil
draw: Tasmanian devil with a stocky dark body, a white chest band, pink ears and an open toothy mouth.

name: opossum
draw: Opossum hanging by its bare ringed tail from a branch, with a white pointed face and round ears.

name: sugar-glider
draw: Sugar glider gliding with a membrane stretched between its legs, big eyes and a stripe down its head.

name: quokka
draw: Quokka sitting with a round face, small rounded ears and a big smile.

name: numbat
draw: Numbat in side view with white stripes across its back, a pointed snout and a bushy tail held up.

name: bilby
draw: Bilby in side view with long rabbit ears, a long pointed snout and a black and white tail.

name: quoll
draw: Quoll in side view with a cat-sized body covered in white spots, a pointed snout and a long tail.

name: thylacine
draw: Thylacine, the extinct Tasmanian tiger, in side view with dark stripes across its back and a stiff tail.

name: tree-kangaroo
draw: Tree kangaroo sitting on a branch with a bear-like face, strong front arms and a long hanging tail.

name: platypus
draw: Platypus seen from above with a flat duck bill, webbed feet and a flat beaver tail.

name: echidna
draw: Echidna in side view with a spiny back and a long thin beak-like snout.

name: donkey
draw: Donkey head in profile with very long upright ears, a pale muzzle and a short upright mane.

name: przewalskis-horse
draw: Przewalski's horse in side view with a stocky body, a short stiff upright mane and a pale muzzle.

name: okapi
draw: Okapi in side view with a giraffe-like head, a plain body and bold horizontal zebra stripes on the legs and rump.

name: tapir
draw: Tapir in side view with a short flexible trunk-like snout and a pale saddle patch across its middle.

name: warthog
draw: Warthog face with two large upward curving tusks, wart bumps on the cheeks and a bristly mane.

name: wild-boar
draw: Wild boar in side view with a bristly ridge along the back, a long snout and short upturned tusks.

name: babirusa
draw: Babirusa head with upper tusks growing up through the snout and curling back toward the forehead.

name: red-river-hog
draw: Red river hog face with long white ear tufts, a pale face stripe and a long snout.

name: pot-bellied-pig
draw: Pot-bellied pig in side view with a swayed back, a sagging belly almost touching the ground and a short snout.

name: mangalica-pig
draw: Mangalica pig in side view covered in a thick curly woolly coat like a sheep.

name: bison
draw: American bison in side view with a massive shoulder hump, shaggy head and beard and short curved horns.

name: yak
draw: Yak in side view with long shaggy hair hanging to the ground, a shoulder hump and wide curved horns.

name: water-buffalo
draw: Water buffalo head with very wide crescent horns sweeping back and out from the top of the head.

name: african-buffalo
draw: Cape buffalo head with horns joined in a heavy boss across the forehead that curve down and then up.

name: zebu
draw: Zebu cow in side view with a large hump over the shoulders, drooping ears and a loose dewlap.

name: highland-cow
draw: Highland cow face with a long shaggy fringe covering the eyes and long wide upcurved horns.

name: longhorn-cattle
draw: Longhorn steer head with extremely long horns stretching wide to both sides.

name: ankole-watusi
draw: Ankole-Watusi cattle head with enormous thick lyre-shaped horns rising up and out.

name: belted-galloway
draw: Belted Galloway cow in side view with a dark shaggy body and a wide white belt around the middle.

name: musk-ox
draw: Musk ox with a long shaggy coat hanging to the ground and heavy horns curving down beside the face.

name: takin
draw: Takin in side view with a bulky golden body, a large arched Roman nose and short horns curving back.

name: gazelle
draw: Gazelle in side view with a slender body, a dark side stripe and ringed lyre-shaped horns.

name: impala
draw: Impala head with long elegant lyre-shaped ringed horns spreading up and outward.

name: springbok
draw: Springbok mid-leap pronking with all four legs stiff and back arched, with short curved horns.

name: oryx
draw: Oryx in side view with very long straight spear-like horns and a black and white face mask.

name: kudu
draw: Greater kudu head with long open spiral corkscrew horns and large rounded ears.

name: eland
draw: Eland in side view with a large heavy body, a hanging dewlap and straight tightly twisted horns.

name: sable-antelope
draw: Sable antelope head with long scimitar horns curving strongly backward and white face stripes.

name: blackbuck
draw: Blackbuck head with two long corkscrew spiral horns forming a V and white eye rings.

name: wildebeest
draw: Wildebeest in side view with a sloping back, a shaggy beard, a mane and cow-like curved horns.

name: hartebeest
draw: Hartebeest head with a very long narrow face and horns rising from a pedicle in a bracket shape.

name: gerenuk
draw: Gerenuk standing upright on its hind legs with a very long thin neck reaching up to a branch.

name: dik-dik
draw: Dik-dik head with a small pointed face, huge round eyes, a short mobile snout and a crest tuft between short horns.

name: klipspringer
draw: Klipspringer standing on the tips of its hooves on a small rock peak with short spike horns.

name: saiga-antelope
draw: Saiga antelope head with a large bulbous drooping nose and translucent short ringed horns.

name: pronghorn
draw: Pronghorn in side view with forked black horns, white bands on the throat and a white rump.

name: bongo
draw: Bongo antelope in side view with thin white vertical stripes on its body and spiral horns.

name: chamois
draw: Chamois head with short upright black horns that hook sharply backward at the tips.

name: mountain-goat
draw: Mountain goat in side view on a ledge with a shaggy white coat, a beard and short black dagger horns.

name: markhor
draw: Markhor head with tall corkscrew horns twisting upward and a long flowing beard.

name: bighorn-sheep
draw: Bighorn sheep head in profile with massive horns curling around in a full circle beside the face.

name: barbary-sheep
draw: Barbary sheep in side view with long fringe hair hanging from throat and front legs and backward curved horns.
